ops.err.no-install: Claude Desktop is not installed on this computer.
ops.err.desktop-running: Claude Desktop is still open. Quit it first, then try again.
ops.err.not-signed-in: Claude Desktop is not signed in. Sign in first, then save.
ops.err.no-current: Save the account Claude Desktop is signed into first.
ops.err.bad-name: “{name}” cannot be a profile name. Use up to 40 letters, digits, spaces, dots, dashes or underscores, starting with a letter or digit.
ops.err.other-account: Claude Desktop is signed into a different account than profile “{name}”, so nothing was changed. Save this login under its own name first.
ops.err.profile-in-use: “{name}” is the profile in use. Switch to another profile first.
ops.err.already-current: “{name}” is already the profile in use.
ops.err.ambiguous-list: “{ref}” matches more than one chat list. Add the organization: account/org.
ops.err.ambiguous-chat.one: “{ref}” matches {n} chat. Use a longer id.
ops.err.ambiguous-chat.other: “{ref}” matches {n} chats. Use a longer id.
ops.err.no-history: This chat has no history left on disk.
ops.err.bad-format: Cannot export as “{format}”. Use md or html.
ops.kind.custom: a data folder chosen by hand
ops.doctor.no-login: Claude Desktop ({kind}) has not been signed in yet
ops.doctor.no-login.fix: Open Claude Desktop and sign in, then save the account.
ops.doctor.leftover: A second Claude data folder is still here
ops.doctor.leftover.detail: {path} was left by the older standalone installer. Claude Desktop reads files it is missing from there, so an old login in it can come back.
ops.doctor.leftover.fix: If you no longer use the standalone app, quit Claude Desktop and move that folder somewhere safe.
ops.doctor.running-unknown: Could not tell whether Claude Desktop is running
ops.doctor.unsaved: The signed-in account is not saved as a profile yet
ops.doctor.mismatch: Profile {name} is in use, but Claude Desktop is signed into another account
ops.doctor.mismatch.detail: Switching and adding accounts are refused until these match, so no saved login is overwritten.
ops.doctor.mismatch.fix: Save this login under its own name: claude-switcher save <name>
ops.doctor.read-failed: Could not read Claude Desktop's chat lists
ops.doctor.no-lists.detail: Claude Desktop creates one the first time you use its Code tab.
ops.doctor.list.signed-in: Claude Desktop is signed into this account
ops.doctor.linked: This chat list is a junction or symbolic link. Claude Desktop reads chats through it but never writes there, so new chats vanish.
ops.doctor.linked.fix: Replace the link with a real folder that holds a copy of the chats.
ops.doctor.ghosts.one: {n} chat in {label} has no history left on disk
ops.doctor.ghosts.other: {n} chats in {label} have no history left on disk
ops.doctor.ghosts.detail: They open empty in Claude Desktop.
ops.doctor.transcripts-unreadable: Could not read Claude Code's chat history
ops.doctor.lost.one: {n} chat is on disk but in no chat list
ops.doctor.lost.other: {n} chats are on disk but in no chat list
ops.doctor.no-lost: Every chat on disk is in a chat list
ops.doctor.desktop-kept: Claude Code keeps Desktop chats however old they are
ops.doctor.desktop-cleanup.one: Claude Code deletes Desktop chats after {n} day
ops.doctor.desktop-cleanup.other: Claude Code deletes Desktop chats after {n} days
ops.doctor.desktop-cleanup.fix: To keep them, remove desktopSessionCleanupPeriodDays from {path}
ops.doctor.terminal-cleanup.one: Chats used only in a terminal are deleted after {n} day
ops.doctor.terminal-cleanup.other: Chats used only in a terminal are deleted after {n} days
ops.doctor.terminal-cleanup.fix: To keep them longer, set cleanupPeriodDays in {path}, for example to 3650
ops.doctor.cowork: Cowork's virtual machine disk is missing
ops.doctor.cowork.detail: Cowork fails to start with “HCS operation failed” until the disk is rebuilt.
ops.doctor.cowork.fix: As administrator, run diskpart and enter: create vdisk file="{path}" maximum=1024 type=expandable
